international.title: Midterm gains by US gun control activists’ signals decline of gun lobby
international.summary: More than 200 people endorsed by Everytown for Gun Safety won state and federal races in loss of dominance for NRA The US midterm elections were not only a big win for the Democrats, but also a huge victory for the gun violence prevention movement, and a sign of the declining power of the once-feared gun lobby. More than 200 people who were endorsed by Everytown for Gun Safety, the prominent umbrella organization for a network of violence prevention groups, won state and federal races, according to data the non-profit shared with the Guardian. And nearly 550 former volunteers for Moms Demand Action, a group that is part of the Everytown network, ran for office as incumbents and first-time candidates. Continue reading...
